args.body: Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The content I could access clearly identifies it as your personal website and makes your contact email easy to find—a useful starting point. I'd suggest adding a short bio and examples of your work or interests so visitors get a stronger sense of who you are. I could only access a brief text snippet, so I can't fairly assess the visual design or navigation.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. The content I could access mentions your love of hiking, which gives the blog a personal touch. I'd suggest building on that with hiking stories, favorite trails, or practical tips to give readers more to explore. I could only access a brief text snippet, so I can't fairly assess the visual design, navigation, or full posts.

final_text:
Visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack at the email listed on her site, and sent both Dora and Eve feedback.

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a short bio and examples of her work or interests.
- **Eve:** Suggested expanding on her hiking interest with stories, favorite trails, or practical tips.

Only brief text snippets were accessible, so I noted that I couldn’t assess the sites’ visual design or navigation.
